notes.title: Geometrics and Mazes updated
notes.content: Enough players have started playing the more difficult content that we have now started tuning those levels. This update tunes the medium difficulty for Geometrics and Mazes. Check it out and get a new high score!

notes.title: Campaign and UI Updates
notes.content:
Several campaigns were updated today under Mazes, Spinners, and Geometrics. The early stages continue to evolve as we tune them based on player metrics. In general, the earlier stages are now slower and static barriers were removed. 

There was also a bug fix for the Campaign Selection screen where the preview levels were not updating correctly in some situations.

Try some of the intermediate and harder levels.  That's where the play styles start to combine in new and fun ways.

notes.title: New Start Menu Design
notes.content: Based on community feedback, we've adjusted the design for the start menu. Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Auto Advance added
notes.content: It was brought to our attention that several players were not aware that there is a select list on the left side of the campaign options screen and therefore were not accessing 90% of the content in the game. We've added a "Next" button to the You Win! screen to auto advance players to the next campaign. We'll be thinking of how to redesign the campaign options screen to better highlight the options and progression. Suggestions are welcome.

notes.title: Campaign Versioning Introduced
notes.content: We've introduced a new way to version campaigns that will also have less impact on leader boards. Unfortunately for this update, all leaderboards will be reset.

notes.title: Spinners Campaign Adjustments
notes.content:
Two new Spinner Campaigns were added to ease players into this style of play. The Slow Set 1 Campaign was shortened by 5 levels. 

Existing players may need to delete the campaign_0001_Casual.hs  file under "Logs" in order for new high scores to post Steam Leaderboards.

Simply playing the game really helps us understand how to tune the levels. Thanks for playing and keep trying to master the levels.
